head_coach.name: Darren Bazeley
head_coach.play_style_summary: Darren Bazeley has implemented a modern, possession-based approach for New Zealand, shifting away from their historically direct style. His tactical blueprint focuses on patient build-up from the back, positional rotation, and a compact central block that transitions quickly into vertical attacks and high pressing.

key_players.name: Chris Wood
key_players.performance_stats: Served as the primary focal point of attack for Nottingham Forest, scoring 3 goals in 15 appearances in 2025/2026. Dominant in aerial duels and physical hold-up play, maintaining a 69.4% pass success rate and winning 26 aerial duels.

key_players.name: Tyler Bindon
key_players.performance_stats: A highly promising defender who spent the 2025/2026 season on loan at Sheffield United, registering 25 appearances and scoring 1 goal. Known for his aerial strength to clear lines and solid positioning in a flat back four.

key_players.name: Marko Stamenić
key_players.performance_stats: Anchored the midfield for Swansea City during the 2025/2026 season with 36 appearances, contributing 3 goals and 2 assists. Highly effective as a defensive shield with strong tackle rates, excellent spatial awareness, and tempo-controlling passes.

injuries_and_absences.absence_reason: Nursing a hamstring strain, which forced him to miss pre-tournament friendlies against Haiti and England, leaving him short of match fitness.
Sidelined with a calf injury that kept him out of warm-up matches, disrupting midfield cohesion ahead of the group stage.
